name: Trello (HTTP)
description: Manage Trello boards, lists, cards, checklists, and more through Trello's official hosted MCP server. Connects via OAuth and exposes tools for reading and writing Trello content within a single authorised workspace.

auth.instructions: Authenticate via Trello's OAuth flow when prompted. The AI client opens a browser to the consent screen where you choose the Trello workspace to authorise. Access is workspace-scoped and revocable from Trello's settings.
